Creating Sustainable Value
Britam is committed to transparent and relevant stakeholder reporting. While this year’s annual report is addressed primarily at our
shareholders, it includes new information relevant to other material stakeholders, including clients, employees, agents, brokers,
regulators and the broader society in which Britam operates.
In developing the content for the annual reporting, we have taken these stakeholders’ considerations and priorities into account.
We are proud to state that this marks the start of our journey towards developing an integrated report that is line with international
standards on integrated reporting.
